rule.page_change_condition: Decision Tree: changed_area_ratio <= changed_area_ratio_threshold => Same Page; otherwise ssim < ssim_threshold => Page Change; otherwise ECC Translation decides Same Page only when ecc_converged is true, ecc_score >= ecc_score_minimum, abs(ecc_dx) <= alignment_translation_maximum_pixels, and abs(ecc_dy) <= alignment_translation_maximum_pixels.
rule.merge_rule: Positive Page Change frames are merged into one Page Change Event only when the actual decoded timestamp gap from the previous positive Change Frame is <= event_merge_gap_seconds.
rule.representative_frame_rule: For each Page Segment, select the frame with maximum laplacian_variance.
